newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seen down on PTCL results.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seen down on PTCL results.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished down on Monday amid bearish sentiment and dealers said the index might edge lower if Pakistan Telecommunication Co Ltd comes up with lower profits for 1995/96 (July-June).
PTCL had a net profit of 16.8 billion rupees in 1994/95.
"A significant drop in PTCL profits could take the market down with it," Anisur Rehman, research head at SocGen-Crosby Securities, said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 24.24 points, or 1.52 percent, to end at 1,574.70. Losers led gainers 212 to 67.
Turnover rose to 43 million shares from 17 million in the previous session.

Muslim Commercial Bank fell 0.75 to 36.75 rupees and Adamjee Insurance 2.0 to 109. Nishat Mills fell 2.90 to 25.50 and Dewan Salman Fibre 0.45 to 39.25. Hub Power Co fell 0.15 to 37.40 and Pakistan State Oil 5.0 to 280. PTCL fell 0.75 to 28.75. ICI Pakistan fell 0.25 to 23.90 anf Fauji Fertilizer 1.50 to 78.50.
